turns.content: A 10-person club must assign four distinct offices: president, vice president, secretary, and treasurer. Explain whether this is an ordered assignment or an unordered selection, and identify what makes two outcomes different.
How many choices are available for president and then vice president? Give the product for those first two assignments.
After those seats are filled, how many choices remain for the third unlabeled committee seat and then the fourth unlabeled committee seat? Give the product for these two selections.
Add the four step counts for the original 10-person club and compute the exact number of complete office assignments.
Check the result by relating the assignment count to choosing a four-person committee and then assigning its members to the four named offices. Explain why the committee count alone is insufficient.
Report the exact number of assignments and briefly state the role-based interpretation of the count.
